metadata.label: MICAS
metadata.coverage: Mission orthophoto registered to USGS terrain, retaining its original lighting. The grid marks missing imagery and an estimated completion of the unmeasured side.

celestial.sunSource: JPL Horizons at the shared 3 September 2026 epoch; explicitly illustrative fixed attitude.
celestial.sunQualification: The DEM image axes are displayed at an arbitrary fixed attitude. Shadows are a lighting aid, not reconstructed encounter illumination.
celestial.qualification: Measured terrain covers the encounter-facing side. The grid marks an illustrative closed surface fitted to each observed outline with an assumed depth; it carries no measured imagery or scalar values.

controls.label: MICAS
controls.notes: The mission team’s orthophoto laid onto USGS terrain, keeping the lighting seen by Deep Space 1. The grid covers missing imagery and the estimated far side.

controls.label: USGS
controls.notes: Terrain reconstructed from overlapping MICAS images, with manual stereo checks. Gray shows measured terrain; the grid fills the far side with an estimated shape.

controls.label: DLR
controls.notes: An independent reconstruction of the encounter images, aligned with USGS at the same scale. The grid marks gaps and the estimated far side.

controls.label: Height
controls.notes: Height toward the spacecraft from the source’s reference plane. This is not distance from the comet’s centre. Turn Shadows off to read the scale.

controls.label: Difference
controls.notes: USGS height minus DLR height after alignment. Colors show model disagreement, not change over time; gray marks missing overlap. Turn Shadows off to read the scale.
